attemptScope: one structured invocation with existing bounded transport retry policy

deliveryContract.capability: Business notes: type a note into an input, add it to a visible list, and open/close a help overlay explaining usage; state is plugin-local and rendered within the host shell.
deliveryContract.placement: Rendered inside the .acme-host shell via the existing AgentMount region, below the current Card with Button/Input, so it inherits ConfigProvider theme tokens and [data-theme] light/dark CSS variables.
deliveryContract.lifecycle: Created on host mount and disposed on host unmount; plugin owns local React state for the notes array, input value, and overlay visibility; no persistence, no network calls, no global state mutation.
dependencies: antd (Button, Input, Card - already in package.json)
interactions: Type note text into the input
Click add button to append a non-empty trimmed note to the top of the list
Empty/whitespace-only input is ignored with inline feedback
Open help overlay via help button
Close help overlay via close button or Escape
Overlay and list re-render correctly across light/dark theme toggle

args.desiredOutcome: A bounded panel plugin that lets a user type a business note, append it to an in-memory list, and consult a help overlay, styled entirely with the existing antd controls and acme-host theme variables with zero new dependencies.
missingCapabilities: Note text input with add-to-list submission and empty-input guard
Append-only rendered notes list with plugin-local state
Help overlay with open/close and Escape-key dismissal
args.uiScope: notes input, notes list, help overlay
args.dataScope: plugin-local in-memory notes array; no host or external data access
reuseEvidenceRefs: src/App.tsx: existing antd Button and Input usage
package.json: antd and react already declared dependencies
